workflows.career: Resume PDF rendering and ATS checks

dependencies.name: Node.js 24+
dependencies.note: Required for every selected workflow. The running Node version is checked. Other executable versions are not queried.

dependencies.name: Git
dependencies.note: File discovery only. Repository access and forge authentication are not tested.

dependencies.name: Chrome, Edge or Chromium
dependencies.note: The checker does not launch a browser or attach to a profile.

dependencies.name: Mermaid CLI
dependencies.note: Without it, diagram-check supports --no-render and reports that rendering is unverified.

dependencies.name: Poppler pdftotext
dependencies.note: Required for ATS text extraction, rather than PDF generation.

dependencies.name: Python
dependencies.note: Image zoom requires Python 3.12+. The imagegen fallback requires Python 3.10+. Interpreter versions are not executed or verified.

dependencies.name: uv
dependencies.note: First image-zoom use installs locked dependencies. This checker never invokes uv.

dependencies.name: Bundled image-zoom server
dependencies.note: Server files are included. Client registration and locked dependency installation remain separate.

dependencies.name: Image-zoom client registration
dependencies.note: Check the MCP client's tool list. Client settings and server state are not inspected.

dependencies.name: System imagegen skill and CLI
dependencies.note: Install the complete upstream system skill separately. IMAGEGEN_SKILL_ROOT may select it.

dependencies.name: Built-in image generation tool
dependencies.note: Confirm the tool in the current harness. Installed instructions cannot expose a missing tool.

dependencies.name: Imagegen fallback dependencies and API access
dependencies.note: The chosen fallback needs openai, pillow and local API credentials. None are imported, read or tested here.

dependencies.name: Web and connected-browser tools
dependencies.note: Confirm source access in the harness. Network and logged-in sessions are not tested.

dependencies.name: Firecrawl MCP
dependencies.note: Optional discovery/scraping route; the research skills retain ordinary web fallbacks.

dependencies.name: curl
dependencies.note: Used by source-specific fetches and wizard checks when those paths are selected.

dependencies.name: yt-dlp
dependencies.note: Used for caption retrieval. Installation and any download remain explicit actions.

dependencies.name: Jev MCP server and provider
dependencies.note: Use the bundled Jev setup guide, then confirm tools in the client. Registration, credentials and provider calls remain unverified.

dependencies.name: npx
dependencies.note: One upstream server launch route. A separately installed server can use another executable path.

dependencies.name: Bash
dependencies.note: Wizard execution requires Bash. Eval shell-syntax coverage is optional and reports its own skipped coverage.

dependencies.name: ShellCheck
dependencies.note: Optional shell analysis when available.

dependencies.name: GitHub CLI
dependencies.note: Other forges use their own connectors. This checker never invokes gh or checks authentication.

dependencies.name: Forge authentication
dependencies.note: Confirm access through the chosen client separately; no credentials are read.

dependencies.name: Bundled optional evaluation toolkit
dependencies.note: Included only with AITUNING_PUBLIC_EVALS=1. Offline checks need no model service.

dependencies.name: Model CLI or API configuration
dependencies.note: Needed only for separately authorized live evaluations. Shipped model targets and judge start disabled.

dependencies.name: .NET SDK
dependencies.note: The project's SDK and package versions remain unverified.

dependencies.name: Cargo toolchain
dependencies.note: Compiler components and project-specific tools remain unverified.

dependencies.name: Project test and architecture tooling
dependencies.note: Use the consuming project's own SDKs, lockfiles and checks. This catalog does not install project dependencies.
